journey.title: Visa journey and department updates
journey.subtitle: Record the current department stage and add concise notes the client can understand. Once finished, consult with the client on next steps.
journey.confirmSave: Are you sure you want to update the application journey?

statusUnlock.default: Update the status if department approves visa or requires further action and explain in the note. All documents must first be approved to continue.
statusUnlock.visa_journey_started: Update to visa journey started once the visa process has been handed over to the relevant departments.
statusUnlock.visa_issue_action_needed: Update to visa issue action needed when the visa process requires additional information or actions before it can continue.
statusUnlock.visa_approved: Update to visa approved once the visa outcome has been confirmed and recorded.
statusUnlock.finished: Update to finished once all steps are complete and the application can be formally closed.
statusUnlock.cancelled: Update to cancelled only when the application has been stopped and will not continue.

hints.statusUnlock: Only advance the status when the relevant documents have been approved and the department has confirmed the next stage.
hints.notePlaceholder: Explain the latest department update, what it means for the client, and any next steps. Keep private internal notes out of this field.
hints.hintNote: Visa application journey notes are permitted even during

documents.title: Review the documents submitted by the client
documents.subtitle: Check the latest upload for each required document. Approve it or request a replacement with a clear client-facing note.
documents.confirmSave: Are you sure you want to update the document status?

bulk.hintStatus: You can bulk update by selecting multiple documents. If you need a specific note for one document, only select that single document before saving (otherwise the note will be applied to all selected documents). If you select “Needs resubmission”, you must add a note explaining why and how to resubmit.

hint.default: After reviewing a document, select it and either approve it or request a resubmission with a note. You can also update the status of multiple documents at once by selecting all relevant documents and performing a bulk action.
hint.approved: Approve the selected document as acceptable.
hint.resubmit: Request a replacement and provide a clear note explaining the issue with the document, along with specific instructions on what the client needs to upload instead.
hint.notePlaceholder: Add any notes regarding the document. If client requires to resubmit, add a note explaining why and how.

documents.noneUploaded: No file uploaded yet. You can only update once the client submits a file.
documents.confirmOverwriteStatus: Some selected documents already have a status. This will overwrite them. Continue?

wizard.title: Visa application workflow
wizard.documentsWaitingSubtitle: Monitor the required documents and follow up with the client if anything is outstanding.
wizard.documentsWaitingHelp: Action: check upload progress. Do not advance the visa journey until every required document has been reviewed and approved.
wizard.documentsReviewSubtitle: Review each latest document version. Approve acceptable documents or mark items for resubmission with a clear explanation.
wizard.documentsReviewHelp: Action: approve or request resubmission for each selected document. A resubmission requires a client-facing note explaining what to fix.
wizard.journeyHelp: Action: update the status only when the department journey has genuinely reached the selected stage. Add a concise client-visible note when useful.
wizard.issueAction: Department action is needed. Record a clear client-facing note explaining the situation and coordinate any additional information or documents directly with the client outside this app.
wizard.outcome: Record the confirmed visa decision from the department. Use the approved status only when approval is confirmed.
wizard.outcomeDeclined: The existing status model does not include a dedicated “visa declined” value. Do not use “cancelled” to record a refusal unless that is your agreed business rule; the status model should be extended before recording refusals distinctly.
wizard.finished: Final handover: mark the application as finished only after the visa or official outcome notice has been handed over to the client and the exchange is complete.
